blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

faq.a: A Fraser Valley board / Paragon sub-area name — one of the three sub-areas of the board's Cloverdale community (Clayton, Cloverdale, Serpentine) — but not a City of Surrey planning or community name, so there is no City boundary or neighbourhood profile for it; the live page's feed under this label shows Surrey acreage, farm and land listings on the city's southern lowland (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What are the market figures for the wider community this sub-area sits in?
faq.a: The Cloverdale board community recorded, for September 2026: Detached 201 active listings, 32 solds, a $1,212,500 median and 19 days on market; Condos & Townhomes 194 listings, 37 solds, a $740,000 median and 32 days — community figures expressly NOT Serpentine's own, with Clayton the fastest-moving sub-area that month (29% detached, 21% attached) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What rules govern the acreage parcels on this page's feed?
faq.a: Parcel by parcel: if a parcel is in the Agricultural Land Reserve, the ALC frame applies — a principal residence capped at 500 m² with any suite inside it, at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (>40 ha), and ALC permission required to subdivide outside limited exceptions; urban Surrey suite, coach-house and SSMUH rules apply only to non-ALR urban lots.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Serpentine?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 1 houses listed with 0 sold in the month in Serpentine. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
